_comment: Editor UI metadata for MPC B-LEG. Overlaid onto the schema built from BLegConfig (a SosFadeConfig superset). UI ONLY — never touches a trade decision or the source hash. Click Scan Strategies after editing. Params not listed here fall back to their raw field names; the A+ gate params (arm sources, FVG/entry, HTF, veto) are inherited from the A+ bot and still matter because the B-LEG keeps the 'A+ has priority' stand-down — see the A+ strategy's own meta for their descriptions.
edge: The B LEG is the SOS whose retrace arrived LATE. A reversal setup fires its shift-of-structure, but price expands and breaks structure AGAIN in the same direction before it ever pulls back — so the normal A+ leg dies at two-thirds with no entry. On a higher timeframe that is one clean leg, and the retrace does come, just later. The B LEG freezes the Sniper-Zone band (0.382–0.5) of that original break and rests a limit at the 0.5 edge; the tap IS the entry. Stop sits beyond the leg origin (fib 1.0); the target ladder is the broken swing extreme, then the expansion extreme, then a runner. Turned on alongside the A+ engine last night it added significant profit, which is why it was split into its own bot to run in parallel. This is the baseline port — faithful to the Pine — before any of its own entry/stop tuning.

steps.label: 01 · SOS
steps.title: A reversal fires
steps.detail: An A+ shift-of-structure prints and freezes its Sniper-Zone band (0.382–0.5 of the break leg). The B LEG watches that band even though the A+ setup itself is still just armed.

steps.label: 02 · Dies at 2/3
steps.title: It breaks structure again first
steps.detail: Price expands and prints a continuation BOS BEFORE retracing, so the A+ reversal leg dies with no entry (neither 0.5 nor 0.618 was tapped). That death is exactly what ARMS the B LEG on the frozen band.

steps.label: 03 · Late retrace
steps.title: Wait for price to come back
steps.detail: A resting limit sits at the band's 0.5 edge for up to a tunable number of days (bleg_max_days). If price trades back into the band, the tap fills it. If it never comes back, or closes past the leg origin, the leg goes stale and is dropped.

steps.label: 04 · Manage
steps.title: Ladder out
steps.detail: Same machinery as the A+ bot: 30% at TP1 (the broken swing extreme) and stop to breakeven, 40% at TP2 (the expansion extreme) and stop to TP1, then trail the runner.

params.name: bleg_max_days
params.label: Days to watch for the late retrace
params.desc: How long a frozen B-LEG band waits for price to trade back into it before it goes stale. Measured in DAYS but converted to a bar count (one day ÷ the chart timeframe), so weekends and the daily close don't burn the clock. Default 1.25 = the original 120 bars on 15m. Lower = quick retraces only; higher = more room. Sweep 1 → 3.
guide: A band waits longer for a late return

params.name: exec_risk_pct
params.label: Risk per trade
params.desc: Fraction of equity risked per trade, sized off the entry-to-stop distance so every trade risks the same R. This bot sizes itself — this is the knob.

params.name: exec_no_late_day
params.label: No entries in the final hour
params.desc: Blocks new entries in the last hour before the gold daily close (17:00 NY), so a fill can't get gapped out over the session break.
